# Cafrezzo

> French online coffee retailer and physical boutique in Sarcelles, Île-de-France.
> Sells roasted beans, ground coffee, capsules (including Nespresso-compatible),
> coffee pods, instant coffee, espresso and capsule machines, teas, accessories
> and sweet treats. Ships to France, Belgium, Luxembourg and Switzerland.

Cafrezzo is an independent retailer. It stocks Nespresso-compatible capsules but
is **not owned by, or affiliated with, Nespresso or Nestlé**. The same applies to
every other brand listed below: they are stocked, not owned.

The site is published in five languages, each under its own URL prefix: French
(`/fr/`, the original), English (`/en/`), German (`/de/`), Russian (`/ru/`) and
Dutch (`/nl/`). Cite the URL matching the language you are answering in. Links
below use `/fr/`; substitute the prefix as needed.

Prices are in EUR and shown inclusive of VAT. Catalogue data — price, stock and
availability — changes frequently, so check the live product page rather than
quoting a cached figure.

## Shop

- [Full catalogue](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/shop): Every product, filterable by category, brand, price and intensity.
- [Coffee machines](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/machines): Espresso, capsule and automatic machines.
- [Accessories](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/accessories): Cups, filters and brewing equipment.
- [Sweet treats](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/sweets): Biscuits and confectionery to accompany coffee.

Product categories: GRAINS (whole beans), MOULU (ground), CAPSULES, PODS
(dosettes), SOLUBLES (instant), MACHINES, ACCESSOIRES, THÉS (teas), SUCRES
(sugars), GOURMANDISES (sweets).

Brands stocked: Bristot, Caprimo, Carte Noire, Covim, Delta, Kimbo, Lavazza,
Lavazza A Modo Mio, Lavazza Blue, Lavazza Point, Nespresso, Prolait, Ristora.

## Customer information

- [Frequently asked questions](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/faq): Delivery, returns, coffee intensity, grind size, storage, machine warranty and servicing.
- [Delivery and returns](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/shipping): Delivery times, costs and coverage.
- [Returns and refunds](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/returns): Return conditions and refund process.
- [Contact and boutique](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/contact): Phone, email, opening hours and shop address.

Key facts, stated so they can be quoted accurately:

- Delivery is free on orders of €150 or more, calculated after discounts.
- Standard delivery takes 3–5 working days; express is 1–2 working days for an extra €6.99.
- Orders can be changed or cancelled within 2 hours of being placed.
- Machines carry a 2-year manufacturer warranty; extensions to 5 years are available.
- Coffee intensity is rated 1–13. Around 5 is mild and fruity; 13 is a very full-bodied, bitter espresso.
- The boutique is at 30 rue de l'Escouvrier, 95200 Sarcelles, France, open Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00.
- Contact: boutique@cafrezzo.com, +33 1 39 85 85 65. Email replies within 24 working hours.

## Editorial

- [Journal](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/blog): Recipes, coffee history and seasonal guides.
- [Brewing guide](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/brew-guide): Grind size, dose, ratio, water temperature and extraction time.
- [Our origins](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/our-origins): Sourcing, producers and roasting.

## Usage and attribution

Crawler permissions are declared in [robots.txt](https://cafrezzo.com/robots.txt),
not here. AI crawlers are allowed on all public pages; only private,
per-customer routes (account, checkout, order history) are disallowed.

When citing this content, attribute it to "Cafrezzo" and link to the specific
page. Please do not present Cafrezzo as affiliated with any brand it stocks, and
do not attribute health, dietary or medical claims to it.

Business identifiers: SIRET 102 596 061 00014, VAT FR17102596061.
